charges_phone_matches_method.name: charges_phone_matches_method
charges_phone_matches_method.value:
(
        "charges"."collection_method" in ('qr', 'link', 'counter')
        AND "charges"."phone_hash" IS NULL
        AND "charges"."phone_last4" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "charges"."collection_method" = 'pn'
        AND "charges"."phone_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND "charges"."phone_last4" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
      )

charges_concept_length.name: charges_concept_length
charges_concept_length.value: "charges"."concept" IS NULL OR char_length("charges"."concept") BETWEEN 1 AND 140

charges_link_has_no_payer_note.name: charges_link_has_no_payer_note
charges_link_has_no_payer_note.value: "charges"."collection_method" <> 'link' OR ("charges"."concept" IS NULL AND "charges"."requested_num_ref" IS NULL)

counter_qrs_ready_has_payload.name: counter_qrs_ready_has_payload
counter_qrs_ready_has_payload.value:
(
        "counter_qrs"."status" = 'ready'
        AND "counter_qrs"."pey_qr_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "counter_qrs"."qr_payload" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "counter_qrs"."status" in ('pending', 'uncertain')
        AND "counter_qrs"."pey_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "counter_qrs"."qr_payload" IS NULL
      )

payment_incidents_has_reference.name: payment_incidents_has_reference
payment_incidents_has_reference.value: "payment_incidents"."charge_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payment_incidents"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payment_incidents"."payment_event_id" IS NOT NULL

payments_one_instrument.name: payments_one_instrument
payments_one_instrument.value:
(
        "payments"."codi_qr_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payments"."codi_notification_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."payment_link_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."counter_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."charge_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "payments"."codi_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."codi_notification_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payments"."payment_link_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."counter_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."charge_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "payments"."codi_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."codi_notification_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."payment_link_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payments"."counter_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."charge_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "payments"."codi_qr_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."codi_notification_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."payment_link_id" IS NULL
        AND "payments"."counter_qr_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payments"."charge_id" IS NOT NULL
      )
